timeBoundary.overlap: never; the exact-expiry second belongs to refund

circleImplementation.openzeppelinContracts: 5.6.x (exact patch release UNVERIFIED; vendored verbatim from the verified source)

patch.change: setBudget requires msg.sender == job.client (was job.provider); no other change

hookPayloads.note: The core calls hook.beforeAction/afterAction(jobId, selector, data). Every data blob begins with address caller (msg.sender of the core call).

createJob.data: abi.encode(address caller, address provider, address evaluator)

setBudget.data: abi.encode(address caller, uint256 amount, bytes optParams)

fund.optParams: abi.encode(bytes32 imageId, bytes32 rulesHash, bytes32 referenceHash) (exactly 96 bytes)
fund.rule: before: budget > 0, provider != 0, expiredAt >= block.timestamp + MIN_EXPIRY_MARGIN. after: status Funded, Terms frozen

submit.data: abi.encode(address caller, bytes32 deliverable, bytes optParams)
submit.optParams: abi.encode(bytes envelope, bytes seal, bytes32 keyCommitment)
submit.rule: before: funded, caller == provider, block.timestamp < expiry, no accepted submission, envelope.length <= MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES, sha256(envelope) == deliverable, verifier.verify(seal, imageId, sha256(journal)). after: store Submission, emit ProofAccepted

complete.data: abi.encode(address caller, bytes32 reason, bytes optParams)
complete.rule: before: only while hook.release is running

reject.data: abi.encode(address caller, bytes32 reason, bytes optParams)
reject.rule: allowed without state changes; the hook never calls reject

encodings.context: 0x01 || chainId[32] || escrow[20] || jobId[32] || provider[20] || rulesHash[32] || referenceHash[32] (169 bytes)
encodings.journal: context || verdict[1] || envelopeHash[32] || keyCommitment[32] (234 bytes); the hook uses verdict 1

inputs.createJob: (provider, evaluator = hook, expiredAt, description, hook = hook)
inputs.setBudget: (jobId, amount, optParams = 0x), sent by the Poster (client)
inputs.fund.optParams: abi.encode(bytes32 imageId, bytes32 rulesHash, bytes32 referenceHash)
inputs.submit.optParams: abi.encode(bytes envelope, bytes seal, bytes32 keyCommitment)

posterTransactions.call: createJob(provider, evaluator = hook, expiredAt, description, hook = hook)
posterTransactions.event: JobCreated(jobId indexed, client indexed, provider indexed, evaluator, expiredAt, hook)

posterTransactions.note: Patched core: only the client may call it, only while the job is Open.
Exactly the budget. fund has no expected-budget argument, so keep the allowance equal to the budget.

posterTransactions.event: JobFunded(jobId indexed, client indexed, amount); then hook TermsFrozen(...)

solverTransactions.events: JobSubmitted(jobId indexed, provider indexed, deliverable); hook ProofAccepted(jobId indexed, envelopeHash, keyCommitment)
solverTransactions.note: A bad proof reverts and the job stays Funded. A garbage seal burns nearly all forwarded gas: set an explicit gas limit.

solverTransactions.events: JobCompleted, PaymentReleased(jobId indexed, provider indexed, amount) from the core; KeyReleased(jobId indexed, provider indexed, key, envelopeHash) from the hook
solverTransactions.note: The key is public in calldata once sent.

refund.when: block.timestamp >= expiredAt and status Funded or Submitted
refund.events: Refunded(jobId indexed, client indexed, amount), JobExpired(jobId indexed)
